summary: BUTIKKDRIFT HOVEVEIEN AS (org. no. 932 397 420) is a private limited company (AS) based in Sandnes, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2023-11-03. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 47.110 (Detaljhandel med bredt vareutvalg med hovedvekt på nærings- og nytelsesmidler); it has 8 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 25.2 m and net income was NOK 818 016. CEO: Marit Indergård Kopstad; board chair: Christian Lykke; auditor: KPMG AS.
